annotations.text:
Direction: calm and airy. Warm off-white canvas, one sage-teal accent, Bricolage Grotesque display with Instrument Sans body, JetBrains Mono for data. One orchestrated reveal on the hero; nothing else moves.
Landing on the left. Product on the right: Chat is the default surface (each message is one private job), Jobs is the ledger of every job.
Chat thread shows the three message states: settled (paid, signature), submitted (approve / reject, auto-approve countdown), and in flight (sealing steps, waiting for a provider).
